learning_objectives.title: Quantum Bits (Qubits)
learning_objectives.description: A classical bit is an electrical circuit, always definitely on or off. A qubit is the state of an elementary particle, such as an electron, ion, or photon, that holds a mix of 0 and 1 at once (superposition) until measured, enabling Grover's Algorithm to search 256 possible codes in far fewer steps than checking them one at a time

learning_objectives.title: Constructive & Destructive Interference
learning_objectives.description: Your Wavelength Clue is like your qubit's own frequency. Applying a gate runs a logic operation on it, and when a teammate reads the interference, matching frequencies reinforce the cell (constructive) while mismatches cancel it out (destructive), the same way overlapping wave amplitudes combine or cancel in a real quantum circuit

learning_objectives.title: Entanglement
learning_objectives.description: Some clues ask whether two qubits in the code match or differ, a simple, tangible stand in for entangled qubits whose states are correlated no matter how far apart they are
